description: Append items to one participant's own wish list (name, optional http(s) URL, optional note), up to 10. Uses their private token. replace=true overwrites the list. Does not reveal who they give a gift to. Only their Secret Santa sees the list, on the website, after revealing.

items.description: Items to add, or the full list when replace is true. At most 10 in total.

note.description: Optional note for the person who will give the gift.

language.description: Language of the reply and the share messages: en, es, ca, de, pt, fr, it, nl, pl, da, no, sv, ru, ko, ja. Defaults from region.

participant_token.description: That person's private token or /s/ URL.

replace.description: When true, replace the whole list instead of appending.

name: add_to_wishlist
title: Add wish list items
